anomalies.observed: The STDBY pins of all three TMC2209 stepper drivers are left unconnected (no-connect nets).
anomalies.expected: The TMC2209 datasheet requires STDBY to be tied to GND for normal operation; leaving it floating puts the driver in standby mode.

evidence.quote: three TMC2209 stepper-motor driver ICs (U5, U6, U7) rather than simple on/off MOSFET pump drivers

anomalies.impact: All three TMC2209 drivers will remain in standby mode and will not drive the stepper motors, so the pH-Down, Nutrient-A, and Nutrient-B dosing pumps will not operate.

parsed.summary: The design files contain a critical open-connection anomaly: the STDBY pins of all three TMC2209 stepper drivers are left floating, which per the datasheet puts them in standby mode and prevents the dosing pumps from running.
